description: 1. The agent must run `node /workspace/node-transfer/scripts/ensure-installed.js /workspace/node-transfer/scripts` and parse the JSON output to confirm `installed: true`. 2. The agent must run `node /workspace/node-transfer/scripts/send.js /workspace/source_data/genome_batch_001.bin` in the background (or a subprocess), capture its stdout JSON, and extract `url`, `token`, and `fileSize`. 3. The agent must run `node /workspace/node-transfer/scripts/receive.js <url> <token> /workspace/received/genome_batch_001.bin --no-progress` — crucially using `--no-progress` to suppress intermediate progress JSON lines, otherwise the final JSON object is mixed with progress objects and hard to parse. Without reading SKILL.md, an agent would not know this flag or the `x-transfer-token` header semantics. 4. The agent must parse the receive.js stdout (which is a single clean JSON object only when `--no-progress` is used) and write its contents to `transfer_manifest.json`. 5. The eval verifies: received file exists and has correct MD5 checksum (50MB binary), manifest.json has `success:true`, `bytesReceived` equals source file size (52428800), `speedMBps > 0`, and `outputPath` is valid.
